menubar.title: Menu bar
menubar.description: Open, save, share and export your project, create new programs (grafcet, ladder) and find the manual, the training modules and the keyboard shortcuts.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.description: The variables, programs and HMI pages of the project. Right-click opens an action menu.

pages.title: Workspace
pages.description: Editors open here, in tabs: grafcets, ladders, variables and HMI pages.

hmiPages.title: HMI pages
hmiPages.description: Draw an animated operator interface linked to the project variables. Right-click this folder to create a page.

simulation.title: Analysis and simulation
simulation.description: Analyse the project, then switch to simulation mode to run it: start, stop or step through it.

crossReference.title: Cross-references
crossReference.description: For each variable, see which programs read it and which write it.

analysis.title: Analysis results
analysis.description: The errors and warnings found in the project. Click to see the details; the colour shows the severity.

toolbar.title: Toolbar
toolbar.description: Drag a step, an action, a transition or a junction onto the canvas. The first tool creates the initial step.

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.description: Drop your elements here. Double-click a step, a transition or an action to edit its text; right-click opens an action menu.

toolbar.title: Contacts and coils
toolbar.description: Drag a contact or a coil onto the canvas. The arrow to the right of the coils shows more of them (inverted, edges).

systemBlocks.title: Library
systemBlocks.description: Timers, counters, comparisons, assignments and calculations: open the palette to place them on a network.

addSection.title: Networks
addSection.description: A Ladder program is a series of networks. This button adds one.

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.description: Drop an element to insert it into a network. Double-click a contact or a coil to choose its variable.

toolbar.title: Widget palette
toolbar.description: Drag a widget or a shape onto the page to build the operator interface.

canvas.title: HMI page
canvas.description: Drop and move your widgets here. Click one to select it.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Link the selected widget to a variable and set its appearance, animations and events.
